Both orders confer competitive status on Federal employees who lack it and use substantially the same machinery: active-duty service in a competitive-service position, agency-head recommendation within a specified period, a most recent efficiency rating of “Good” or better (or agency certification of six months of meritorious service), one suitable noncompetitive Civil Service Commission examination, and Commission implementing regulations. The child reorganizes and broadens C20’s eligibility rule, adds exclusions, and changes the service-period requirements, but preserves the distinctive operative framework and substantial language.
